inputs.name: GameImageService.constructor.session
inputs.description: The project-session service used to validate the requested project and obtain mutable or required project state. It must be supplied when constructing the service.

inputs.name: GameImageService.constructor.adapter
inputs.description: The adapter whose generate method receives the project API key and assembled image prompt. Defaults to new GptImageAdapter().

inputs.name: GameImageService.generate.input
inputs.description: A game-image request; the service reads its projectId, document, viewId, checkpointId, and expectedRevision. Generation requires a selected checkpoint in a ready view and a saved revision equal to expectedRevision.

checkpoints.imagePrompt: Warm sunrise filtering through pine trees.
checkpoints.title: Old Bridge
checkpoints.description: Reach the weathered bridge at the forest edge.

inputs.name: GameImageService.read.input
inputs.description: A game-image read request; the service validates projectId and forwards path and commit to the checkpoint-image repository. The full request shape comes from GameDesktopBridge.

outputs.name: GameImageService.generate
outputs.description: Resolves to an image record and a PNG data URL. The image record has path, model (fixed to gpt-image-2), prompt, and ISO createdAt; the assembled prompt is limited to 20,000 characters.

image.prompt:
Create a polished gameplay checkpoint image, a visual target for a game.
Keep consistent characters, environment and art direction. Show the checkpoint state. No HUD, text labels or UI.
View: Forest Crossing (2d). Style: hand-painted pixel art
Checkpoint: Old Bridge. Guidance: Reach the weathered bridge at the forest edge.
Visual direction: Warm sunrise filtering through pine trees.
Prerequisites: []
Conditions: []
Consequences: []

outputs.name: GameImageService.read
outputs.description: Resolves to the value returned by CheckpointImageRepository.read for the supplied path and commit; this service does not define that value's shape.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error is thrown when the document or selected checkpoint is invalid, the view is not ready, the saved game revision is stale, another game operation is active, or the assembled prompt exceeds 20,000 characters.
